steps.title: Select Target Individuals
steps.instruction: Systematically select individuals across the majority of species in the park, aiming for 10 individuals of abundant species and 5 of less abundant species.

substeps.instruction: Ensure leaves are mature, healthy, and fully sunlit (>3hrs sunlight/day).
Ensure target leaves are ≤ 20 m above the forest floor.
Select individuals located within 30 mins (ideally 15 mins) from the mobile laboratory.
Distribute selected individuals of the same species across different sectors and altitudinal gradients.

steps.title: Tag Selected Individuals
steps.instruction: Physically mark each selected individual for identification and relocation.

substeps.instruction: Attach a numbered aluminum tag at breast height (~1.5 m) on the side of the trunk facing away from the trail.
Hammer the nail at a downward angle so the tag is not flush against the bark.
Apply flagging tape at breast height as a temporary marker for relocation.

steps.title: Create Initial Plant Record in Fulcrum
steps.instruction: Create a digital record for each individual using the Fulcrum mobile app.

substeps.instruction: Open the Plants app, select '+ Record', choose the project (e.g., 2019-CROFTS-PHD-UDES), and select the appropriate Site (e.g., MtMeg-1).
Answer 'YES' to 'Plant Tagged?', enter the Tag ID, and set Tag Type as 'aluminum tag'.
Take photos of the individual using the camera icon and add any necessary remarks.
List the names of the surveyors who first observed the plant.
Select 'UPDATE LOCATION WITH GPS' to automatically fill Latitude, Longitude, Horizontal Accuracy, and Altitude.
Select 'VASCAN Taxon' and choose the species from the drop-down list (refer to VASCAN website if field guide names differ).
Enter the name of the surveyor who identified the plant and the Identification Protocol used.
Select 'SAVE' (do not use 'SAVE as Draft') and sync the app using the circular arrows icon.

steps.title: Measure Plant Dimensions
steps.instruction: Quantify the height, diameter at breast height (DBH), and crown diameter for each individual.

substeps.instruction: In the Fulcrum plant record, select 'Size Measurements' -> '+ Record', then select 'DBH', 'Height', and 'Crown Diameter' and select 'DONE'.

Measure height using LaserGeo's HEIGHT 3P function (measuring distance to trunk at eye-level, angle to base, and angle to crown tip). Aim to stand ~10 m away. If the tree is angled, have a second surveyor stand below the crown tip to calculate height.
Measure DBH using a DBH tape at ~1.5 m (or above any obstructions like branches or scars).
Measure the longest crown diameter using the LaserGeo's DME function.
Enter the measured values into the corresponding Height (m), DBH (cm), and Crown diameter (m/cm) fields in Fulcrum.
Select 'SAVE' and exit the Size Measurements menu using the left arrow.

steps.title: Update GPS Coordinates with High Precision
steps.instruction: Return to tagged individuals to obtain precise coordinates using a Trimble Catalyst (DA1 antenna with RTX correction) or similar high-precision GPS.

substeps.instruction: Open the specific plant record in the Fulcrum Plants app.
Select 'UPDATE LOCATION WITH GPS' once a connection is established and horizontal accuracy is ideally ≤ 2.0 m (or the most precise possible if cellular reception is limited).
Change 'RECORD STATUS' from 'PENDING VERIFICATION' to 'VERIFIED' (bar changes from orange to blue).
Save the record and sync Fulcrum.

steps.title: Finalize Records and Export Data
steps.instruction: Complete the digital records after the foliar sampling campaign and export the dataset.

substeps.instruction: Once data is checked, change the status of all plant records from 'VERIFIED' to 'SUBMITTED' (bar changes from blue to green).
Save and sync all records in Fulcrum.
Remove flagging tape from individuals after harvesting and GPS updates.
Using the Fulcrum desktop website, select 'Export Data', choose the file format, select 'Plants' in Apps, select the project (e.g., 2019-CROFTS-PHD-UDES), and confirm the download.
